questions.q: Bucket size 60 s. Timestamp 3725. What is the bucket start?
Why keep empty buckets with a count of 0?
options: Charts and models need a regular time grid
why: It is not required by Python.

questions.q: Scenario: events at minutes 0, 20, 55, 100; new session if gap > 30. How many sessions?
why: Gaps are 20, 35, 45; two of them are above 30, so 2 sessions would be too few.
Correct: gaps 35 and 45 are above 30, so there are 3 sessions: {0, 20}, {55}, {100}.
The first gap (20) is within the limit, so the first two events share a session.

questions.q: Scenario: your pandas sessions merge two different users into one session. What is the most likely bug?
options: The diff was not computed per user
why: The index type is not the cause.

questions.q: What is the time cost of the pure Python sessionization?
options: O(n log n), dominated by the sort

questions.q: Scenario: two events of one user have the same timestamp. What should you do?
options: Treat the gap as 0 (same session) and keep both events
why: Correct: gap 0 is not more than the limit.
A gap of 0 is within the limit.
